scope: Full-length gallery previews of Album (16:9 and 9:16), Comedy, Doodle and DV Story, rendered at half scale from the current template code. Starter keeps its 2026-10-21 full-length preview. Automated checks plus a review of frames sampled every 4 s; not a frame-by-frame or subjective listening acceptance.

renders.renderCommand: npx remotion render examples/cases.tsx VVV-Doodle OUT.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=24 --audio-bitrate=128k
renders.encodeCommand: ffmpeg -i OUT.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 28 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a copy PUBLIC.mp4

checks.message: Short side is 540px; review delivery quality at 1080px or more.
Mean level -16.5 dBFS.
No still stretch longer than 3s.
Strongest visual changes sit 44 ms from the nearest beat on average.

beatMaps: Film-time beat maps built like vvv check --project: the fixture track minus trimBeforeSec, plus later tracks from catalog check.tracks (Comedy switches to When in Love at 110.82 s).
changes: Doodle: hits.json recalibrated with scripts/calibrate.py; the stored hits predated the current page choreography and sat 0.17–0.37 s off.

Doodle: design-beat warp anchors are dropped within 1.5 beats of measured peaks that sit off the design grid, so those page changes can move onto the music. Full-film beat sync went from 111 ms to 44 ms mean.
visualReview: Frames every 4 s of each public file reviewed as tiled sheets: complete, no black or frozen frames outside the designed intros, Doodle page motion unchanged in character after the warp change.
